visualCharacteristics.purpose: Live runway operating direction widget with status panel and explanation
visualCharacteristics.layout: Runway graphic, coloured status panel and text column side by side from 960px; stacked below
notable: Status items: operating direction, active runway, weather category, with a 'Stand' timestamp
Optional JSON source re-renders the panel; authored values are the snapshot
A lone widget-page link is embedded as an iframe

contentPattern.structure: One row: graphic cell (picture), status cell (heading per status item followed by value lines, last 'Stand …' paragraph), text cell (copy and details link); optional config row source | url

usage: Use on airport operations pages to show the current runway operating direction.
reuseGuidance: Built for the operating-direction feed only; use key-figures for static numbers.
